title: Contract Onboarding Fastpass and Exposure Scorecard Playbook
creator: Maya Kapoor
description:
Summary: Define and ship a playbook + lightweight automation for fast-tracking low-risk MSA/DPA redlines at contract intake (Sales preflight) while ensuring auditable escalation for mid/high-risk cases. This ticket scopes the scorecard, decision thresholds, required UI changes in the Sales contract intake flow, and the backend scoring service.

Goals:
- Reduce legal review time for low-risk customers from median 7 days to <24 hours via auto-approve or templated counterproposal.
- Surface clear exposure signals (liability cap, indemnity carveouts, data residency/GDPR flags) to Sales in real time.
- Capture telemetry for score distribution, time-to-closure, and post-signature incidents.

Scope (in/out):
- In: MSA/DPA intake triage for new enterprise accounts; automated score computation; Sales UI preflight with inline recommendations; audit log entries for all auto-actions.
- Out: Full legal negotiation flow, manual back-and-forth redline editor, billing system changes. Those will be follow-ups.

Scorecard & decision heuristic (high level):
- Feature-set: boolean flags (data residency required, HSM/KMS required), numeric fields (requested liability cap in USD, indemnity carveouts count), vendor risk signal (customer industry high-regulated?), and usage-based signal (expected monthly spend).
- Scoring: weighted sum with explainable buckets: ExposureScore = (LiabilityWeight * liability_index) + (IndemnityWeight * indemnity_index) + (DataResidencyWeight * residency_flag) + (SpendWeight * spend_bucket) + (IndustryWeight * industry_risk). We will document weights in Confluence and make them tunable in the admin console.
- Thresholds (initial):
  - Fastpass (auto-approve template): ExposureScore <= 15 AND liability_cap <= 250k AND indemnity_carveouts == 0 AND residency_flag == false.
  - Sales-approved (requires sales manager signoff): ExposureScore 16-40 OR liability_cap 250k-1M OR single indemnity carveout.
  - Legal review required: ExposureScore > 40 OR liability_cap > 1M OR >=2 indemnity carveouts OR residency_flag == true for certain regions.

Trade-offs considered:
- Conservative thresholds reduce legal burden but increase Salesforce friction; aggressive thresholds risk downstream incidents and insurance exposure. We recommend starting conservative and iterating with telemetry.
- Implementing a full rules-engine is heavier; we will ship an initial tunable weights service (simple REST endpoint + admin config) and plan rules-engine replacement in Q3 if needed.

Implementation notes:
- Backend: small scoring microservice in platform-contracts repo. Expose REST endpoint /triage/score and webhook for approvals. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7894
- Frontend: Sales UI preflight modal in Console -> Contracts intake. Mockups & copy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENT/Contract+Fastpass (design v1 attached).
- Audit & Telemetry: send events to analytics pipeline: contract.triage_scored, contract.fastpass_action, contract.escalation_opened. Dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.ai/dashboards/contract-triage
- Templates: create two counterproposal templates (Fastpass MSA, Fastpass DPA) stored in Drive: https://drive.google.com/contract-playbook

Integrations:
- CRM: Salesforce signal to pre-populate expected spend and industry.
- Legal queue: integrate with Zendesk/LegalOps for auto-created tickets when escalation required.

Acceptance criteria: (see AC checklist below)

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: mis-scoring a high-exposure deal and auto-approving. Mitigation: add randomized sampling (1% of fastpass deals flagged for manual review), send summary digest to Legal daily.
- Risk: Sales bypassing preflight. Mitigation: soft enforcement in initial release, enforce after 4 weeks if adoption metrics show compliance <80%.

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENT/Contract+Fastpass
- Design mockups: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=71829271
- Drive templates: https://drive.google.com/contract-playbook
- GitHub PR (backend): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7894
- Analytics dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.ai/dashboards/contract-triage

Acceptance criteria checklist:
1) Scoring microservice deployed to staging and responding to test vectors.
2) Sales Console shows preflight modal with computed score and recommended action.
3) Fastpass template can be applied automatically for scores in Fastpass tier and generates an audit entry.
4) Escalation tickets created automatically in Legal queue for Legal-tier scores with required metadata.
5) Telemetry events emitted and dashboard surfaces score distribution and time-to-resolution.
6) Legal approves final thresholds and signs off on sampling plan.

Next steps (short):
- 2025-02-11: Engineering spike to prototype scoring model and wireframe API (owner: Ravi Singh).
- 2025-02-14: Legal review of initial thresholds and templates (owner: Jordan Lee).
- 2025-02-17: Design pass on Sales preflight modal and copy (owner: Asha Patel).
- 2025-02-20: Stakeholder demo and decision on go/no-go for phased rollout.

Notes for follow-ups: document telemetry-based threshold tuning process and a rollback runbook for incidents that correlate to contract fastpass approvals.

acceptance_criteria: Scoring service returns expected scores for canonical test vectors and documented edge cases.
Sales Console preflight modal displays score, contributing signals, and recommended action.
Fastpass counterproposal template can be applied programmatically and audit entry emitted for each action.
Legal queue receives auto-created tickets for escalations with complete metadata (customer name, score breakdown, requested liability, indemnity carveouts, data residency).
Telemetry dashboard shows baseline metrics and sampling alert if threshold tuning is recommended.
Legal has approved sampling policy and threshold tuning cadence.
